note: Both sets suffer from significant misbinding errors on Figure 2-11, incorrectly identifying the blade's outer airfoil contour as structural centers (e.g., claiming shear center is at -4m, which is the blade surface). Both sets also contain internal contradictions with multiple conflicting values for the same property at the same span location (e.g., mass density 3100 vs 3000 kg/m at r/R=0). Set A is slightly better because Set B includes an additional incorrect claim (mass density 0 kg/m at r/R=1.0, contradicting the 100 kg/m claim also present) and more duplicate entries, violating the preference for fewer wrong claims.
remarks: Both sets fail to distinguish between the blade planform outline and the internal structural axis lines in Figure 2-11. The extraction logic seems to grab any number near a label without verifying the specific line color/style in the legend.
